# Pitcher-mix layers (tuning season)

*Generated by `pipeline/05_mixes.R` on 2026-10-08. Scored on 2025 pitches using only earlier games.*

Each layer is a pitch-mix estimate for one pitcher, in one game, against one batter hand. None of them looks at the count or the situation: that's the job of the context model in `logistic_results.md`.

## The ladder

| layer | pitches | log_loss | top1 | family_log_loss |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 prior mix (Phase 1 baseline) | 707,559 | 1.559 | 39.2% | 0.914 |
| L1 prior mix + relabel repair | 707,559 | 1.558 | 39.2% | 0.914 |
| L2 + current form (season to date) | 707,559 | 1.368 | 41.1% | 0.885 |
| L3 + platoon tilt vs. batter hand | 707,559 | 1.344 | 42.0% | 0.871 |

*Family log loss and accuracy collapse the 8 pitches into fastball (FF, SI, FC), breaking (SL, ST, CU) and offspeed (CH, FS).*

Tuned settings: current form starts from **10 pitches' worth** of his prior mix (tau_std), and the platoon tilt starts from **400 pitches' worth** of his overall mix (tau_hand).

## Relabel repair

A relabel is detected before a game when a pitch that was at least 5% of his history has not appeared this season (30+ pitches in), while a pitch he almost never threw (under 2%) now makes up 5%+, and the two have nearly the same velocity (within 2 mph) and movement (within 4 inches). His history of the old label is then credited to the new one. Only earlier games are used.

| pitcher-games | with 50+ pitches so far | flagged mix change | relabel repaired |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20,737 | 18,862 | 3,844 | 42 |

Effect on the pitcher-games where a relabel was repaired:

| pitches | log_loss | version |
|---|---|---|
| 2,027 | 2.023 | L1 without repair |
| 2,027 | 1.575 | L1 with repair |

## Mix-change flag

A pitcher-game is flagged when he has an established history (200+ weighted pitches) and his season-to-date mix (50+ pitches) is both statistically inconsistent with his prior mix (G-test, p < 0.001) and meaningfully different (at least 20% of his pitches moved to other types). The flag is a model input and is shown in the app.
